publisher: Roberts and Dunbar, Human Nature 26(4):426-450 (2015); University of Kansas News Service (2018) for Hall's hours
table: Roberts and Dunbar (2015) Table 3 and Results H1 (emotional closeness 1 to 10 over three waves nine months apart); Hall (2018) as released by KU News
title: How closeness changes with and without contact, kin against friends
universe: Roberts and Dunbar: 25 English school leavers' whole active networks (kin and friends), aged 17 to 19 at the start; Hall: 355 adults who had recently moved and 112 first-year students
limits: A small panel across a life transition (leaving school), so friends' decline is likely faster than among settled adults; emotional closeness is a 1 to 10 rating, not hours together, so any mapping onto the game's 0 to 1 closeness is a rescale, not a measure. No study read gives a half-life of closeness without contact. These figures check the direction and rough size of a town's change over a year; they decide no tie.

kinClosenessPerWave.unit: points on a 1 to 10 scale per wave (nine months)
kinClosenessPerWave.quote: There was a significant increase in emotional closeness for family ( b = 0.27, t 542.10 = 7.28, p < 0.001)
kinClosenessPerWave.intervalFrom: b plus or minus 1.96 standard errors, the standard error being b / t = 0.037

friendClosenessPerWave.unit: points on a 1 to 10 scale per wave (nine months)
friendClosenessPerWave.quote: a significant decrease in emotional closeness for friends ( b = −0.62, t 786.57 = −15.23, p < 0.001)
friendClosenessPerWave.intervalFrom: b plus or minus 1.96 standard errors, the standard error being b / t = 0.041

innerLayerKept18Months.unit: percent of inner-layer ties still inner after 18 months
innerLayerKept18Months.quote: of 145 kin in the inner layer at T1, 102 (70.3%) were still in the inner layer at T3, whereas only 69 of the 142 friends in the inner layer at T1 (48.6%) remained in the inner layer at T3

waveSpacingMonths.quote: at two further time points: 9 months (T2) and 18 months (T3: end of first calendar year at university, or equivalent)

hoursToFriend.quote: it takes between 40 and 60 hours to form a casual friendship ... 80-100 hours to transition to being a friend ... more than 200 hours together to become good friends

band.measure: mean change in closeness over one played year, 0 to 1 scale, by tie kind
band.conversion: points per wave x (12 / 9 waves per year) / 9 (the width of the 1 to 10 scale)
